data.title: Tooltip
data.tagline: Explain a compact control with a short text label
data.description: A tooltip gives a brief label or hint for an icon or unfamiliar control. It should appear on keyboard focus as well as hover and must not contain essential instructions. If the content is longer or interactive, use a Popover.

use: Give a short hint for an unfamiliar control
Show the full value of truncated text
avoid: Hide required instructions inside a tooltip
Put links or forms inside it
Repeat a label that is already visible
Support hover only and ignore keyboard or touch

explanation.title: Tooltip vs Popover: which one should you use?
explanation.text: Use a Tooltip for a short, read-only explanation. Use a Popover for longer information or controls people need to interact with. Content scope: Tooltip — One short label or hint.; Popover — Longer information, links, buttons, or form controls.. Interactivity: Tooltip — Read-only and available on keyboard focus as well as hover.; Popover — Can remain open while someone clicks or types inside it.. Best fit: Tooltip — Explaining an icon button, truncated title, or abbreviation.; Popover — Showing contextual details, a small set of options, or a compact form.. Configuring a file export button: If a download icon only needs to display the text “Download report” on hover or focus, choose a Tooltip. If clicking the icon lets users choose between PDF and CSV before initiating the export, use a Popover so they can interact with the options.

lessonPractice.title: An icon-only toolbar button needs the label Download report on mouse hover or keyboard focus. What should be used?

options.label: Attach a text tooltip that opens on both hover and focus
options.feedback: A short label explains the icon, and supporting both mouse and keyboard makes the hint reachable.

options.label: Open a card with format choices and a confirmation button
options.feedback: The task only needs to explain the icon, not an interactive layer with choices and actions.

options.label: Explain the icon in a message only after download is clicked
options.feedback: People need to understand the control before acting, so a message after the click arrives too late.

data.agentPrompt: Add a Download report tooltip to the icon, opening on hover and keyboard focus and closing on leave or blur. Keep format choices and errors outside it, and verify the action remains understandable on touch.
